title: Catalogue
summary: CATALOGUE, noun A list or enumeration of the names of men or things disposed in a certain order, often in alphabetical order; as a catalogue of the students of a college, or of books, or of the stars.

inlines.v: CATALOGUE, noun A list or enumeration of the names of men or things disposed in a certain order, often in alphabetical order; as a catalogue of the students of a college, or of books, or of the stars. CATALOGUE, verb transitive To make a list of.
